expected.raw_text: research or applied science experience in machine learning

parsed.degree_signal: A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field.
parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are optional.
Research-area bullets introduced by 'Work may include' describe potential responsibilities, not additional candidate requirements; technologies appearing only there or in company/team descriptions and benefits are excluded.
The minimum-qualification alternatives are pre-training, post-training or reinforcement learning. Only reinforcement learning has a taxonomy entry, so no singleton alternative_group is emitted; group 2 identifies the mapped members of the subsequent preferred-experience alternatives.
Pre-training and post-training are not equated with fine-tuning. Generative retrieval is not equated with RAG.
Online experimentation is tentatively mapped to A/B Testing; the posting does not explicitly name A/B tests, so this mapping is flagged for review.
The large-language-model sentence explicitly requires distributed-training experience; on a literal reading, it does not separately require prior LLM experience.
Commerce knowledge and degree-field names are excluded as domain knowledge rather than technical skills.
